name: AnimatedIcon
description: A widget that displays an animated icon that can be controlled via an AnimationController. Useful for animated transitions between icon states.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: The type of animated icon to display. This defines the animation between two icon states.
properties.possible_values: Any AnimatedIcons built-in icons, e.g., AnimatedIcons.menu_close, AnimatedIcons.play_pause, AnimatedIcons.add_event, etc.

properties.name: progress
properties.description: Controls the animation of the icon. The value should typically be between 0.0 and 1.0.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size of the icon in logical pixels.

properties.name: color
properties.description: The color to use when painting the icon.

properties.name: textDirection
properties.description: The text direction to use for rendering icons that depend on text direction (like arrow animations).
